title: Prove the release candidate in the registered Mez Systems web consumer
objective: After the Figma companion, priority Product UI scope and whole-system certification are complete, register one exact repository as CON-MEZ-SYSTEMS-WEB-001, integrate the later approved immutable candidate without copied design values, and prove real-consumer installation, accessibility, performance, update, rollback and version visibility before any production release or deployment decision.

included: register one exact repository path and remote identity for CON-MEZ-SYSTEMS-WEB-001
install or vendor the later CERT-01-approved immutable package through one versioned package boundary
map consumer-owned routes, analytics, SEO, consent and live content into the package interfaces
prove package name, version and manifest visibility in the running consumer
prove keyboard, focus, screen-reader output, reduced motion, no-WebGL, missing-media and physical-pointer behaviour in the consumer
profile CPU, memory, battery-sensitive motion and video behaviour on named target devices
prove an immutable update and rollback without copying design values or reverting consumer-owned content
present the exact consumer revision and evidence at a human gate
excluded: deploying the consumer before the PORT-04 human gate
changing canonical design, component, content-boundary or motion decisions
copying token, component, renderer or identity source into the consumer
treating frozen testimonial examples as live content truth
assuming third-party mark permission without consumer legal and attribution confirmation

requiredFiles: later immutable candidate and manifest approved by H-CERT-01-SYSTEM-CERTIFICATION

acceptance: one immutable package boundary supplies every design-system value and runtime asset
the live diagnostic exposes package name, version and manifest hash
consumer-owned routes, analytics, SEO, consent and current content remain outside design-system authority
the consumer test suite proves accessibility, fallbacks, named-device performance, update and rollback
no publish, production version assignment or deployment occurs before the human gate
the registered repository and exact consumer revision are recorded
every required check records method, device or browser, result and evidence
previous, candidate and rollback manifest hashes are explicit
known gaps and the final human decision remain honest

verification.passCondition: the exact local checkout, GitHub remote, default branch and approved rc.2 manifest resolve through CON-MEZ-SYSTEMS-WEB-001 without authorising consumer mutation or deployment
the consumer resolves one immutable package version and contains no copied canonical design value or cross-repository runtime import
version visibility, an immutable update and restoration of the last known-good manifest pass without reverting consumer-owned content
keyboard, visible focus, spoken screen-reader output, reduced motion, no-WebGL and missing-media states preserve complete meaning in the real consumer
physical hover and motion recovery behave as specified and named target devices record acceptable CPU, memory, video and battery-sensitive behaviour
Olli accepts, revises or rejects the exact registered-consumer proof before production release or deployment

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Does the exact registered consumer revision prove the later CERT-01-approved package boundary, accessibility, performance, version visibility, update and rollback well enough to prepare a separate production release and deployment decision?

stopConditions: the registered local checkout, GitHub remote or default branch no longer matches CON-MEZ-SYSTEMS-WEB-001
FIG-01, UI-01 or CERT-01 is incomplete
the candidate manifest differs from the later manifest approved at H-CERT-01-SYSTEM-CERTIFICATION
integration requires copied design values or a runtime import from the canonical checkout
a consumer-owned route, consent, analytics, SEO or content decision is guessed rather than supplied
third-party mark permission or testimonial freshness is represented as current without consumer evidence
the work would publish, deploy or assign production version 1.0.0 before the human gate
notes: PORT-03 is complete and rc.1 remains an approved frozen portability milestone.
SEQ-CONSUMER-LAST-001 makes this the final transition after Figma, the agreed current release scope and whole-system certification.
FIG-01, UI-01 and CERT-01 are complete, exact 1.0.0-rc.2 is approved, and Olli registered mezcorp-studio/ceos-notion-landingpage as CON-MEZ-SYSTEMS-WEB-001 on 29 July 2026.
The first consumer action was a read-only forensic audit from a fresh worktree based on fetched origin/main; registration itself granted no mutation or deployment authority.

Olli approved the bounded integration slices, root cutover, canonical AI OS, variants, Agency Supply preservation, support and legal foundations, 404 and checkout shell before the consumer was merged and deployed.

The production consumer uses a vendored immutable adapter scoped beneath .mz-site. This closes the named-consumer proof without publishing @mez-systems/design-system-web, assigning production version 1.0.0 or making the consumer a second design authority.
